metadata.scope: All 382 current service-delivering UK principal local authorities: 361 ONS May 2026 districts/unitaries/council areas plus 21 English county councils. Includes City of London and Isles of Scilly.
metadata.excluded: Combined authorities, combined county authorities, Greater London Authority, parish/town/community councils, national park/fire/police authorities, and future/shadow councils are distinct layers and excluded.
metadata.surrey_transition: The existing Surrey county and 11 district/borough councils remain service-delivering authorities until 31 March 2027. East and West Surrey shadow councils prepare for service responsibility from 1 April 2027; do not prematurely replace the current 12.
metadata.limitations: Council homepage URLs are sourced from the GOV.UK directory, not individually availability-tested. Logos are not supplied by this roster. GSS codes identify current statistical geography, while the GOV.UK entity id/slug assists identity matching; retain both when updating boundaries. No new relationship or endorsement is established by listing a council.
